limitations: Headless SwiftShader validation is not a physical-device FPS, power, thermal or long-session memory benchmark.
884x700 is a Fold-inner-like viewport check, not physical Fold hardware.
Hidden-state checks synthetically override document.hidden and dispatch visibilitychange; no real browser-tab-switching claim.
Shared-holder transfer validates one canvas identity/context lifecycle; the browser Fullscreen API itself is not invoked.

Summer Valley uses bounded two-native-RAF bursts and paused readback drains. Its DOM pointer sequence is explicitly synthetic but traverses the actual event listener, shared host and geometric raycast. Pond and Pebble use browser mouse drag/tap plus synthetic cancellation/outside-release events.
An earlier Summer Valley eight-frame SwiftShader readback exceeded90seconds; this is preserved as an execution limitation, not relabeled a hardware performance pass.
